No. 2057/34 – FRIDAY FEBRUARY 09, 2018
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No. : BGAMA/PD/2/2/88. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/6/2014/HW/288.
I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired :

Lot No. 01-15 allotments of land in Total Extent of about 0.2583 Hectare, in Preliminary Plan No. Ga 4295 prepared by the Sinior –Superintendent of Surveyor of Galle District on behalf of the Surveyor General, situated in the Villages of Ganegama South and Walpita North in the Grama Niladhari Division of 220A - Ganegama East and 206C-Kimbi Ela in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Baddegama in Galle District in the Sourthern Province.

01. Lot No. 01 Name of the land: Lindalangawathurawa; Description: Approach Road and Waste Land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Pushpa Malathi Senavirathne, Peragasduwa, Kimbi Ela, Baddegama; Extent 0.0266 Hectare.

02. Lot No. 02 Name of the land: Lindalangawathurawa; Description: Retaing Wall; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Puchpa Malathi Senavirathne, Peragasduwa, Kimbi Ela, Baddegama; Extent 0.0019 Hectare.

03. Lot No. 03 Name of the land: Pawulagodella alies Peragasduwa; Description: Retaing Wall; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Haresh Senavirathne, Peragasduwa, Kimbi Ela, Baddegama; Extent 0.0003 Hectare.

04. Lot No. 04 Name of the land: Pawulagodella alias Peragsduwa ; Description: Weste Land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Haresh Senavirathne, Peragasduwa, Kimbi Ela, Baddegama; Extent 0.0009 Hectare.

05. Lot No. 05 Name of the land: Mahawathurawa; Description: Waste Land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Weragoda Vidanalage Jinapriya, “Priyawasa”, Kimbi Ela, Baddegama (a part of Lot 601 in Preliminary Plan No. Y213); Extent 0.0204 Hectare.
06. Lot No. 06 Name of the land: —; Description: Waste Land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: -(a part of Lot 3 of acquired in Preliminary Plan No. 1662); Extent 0.0128 Hectare.
07. Lot No. 07 Name of the land: —; Description: Bunt and Reservation; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: -(a part of Lot 3 of acquired in Preliminary Plan No. 1662); Extent 0.1509 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agent duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat office of Baddegama on the 28.03.2018 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 21.03.2018, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulatrs of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
I. HIMALI RATHNAWEERA, Divisional Secretary and Land Acquisition Officer,
